title: Deep Learning Enables 60% Accelerated Volumetric Brain MRI While Preserving Quantitative Performance: A Prospective, Multicenter, Multireader Trial.
summary: Primary prospective multicenter/multireader trial: 40 subjects at five institutions/six scanners; vendor-agnostic CNN enhancement of 60%-faster MRI; quantitative volumetrics and clinical disease classification matched standard of care, with blinded readers rating quality. Small sample, industry-affiliated authors and no downstream workflow outcome.
